architecture: Daemon feature-gated imports register local and RADIUS plugins; local init claims the shared subscriber slot, configured RADIUS replaces it. L2TP already resolves the slot per request; PPPoE needs the drain/subsystem pair. Kernel workers transfer channel/unit ownership through the reactor to the shared PPP Driver. Config coordinator commit is reversible by hub compensation; only the outer accepted event permits irreversible RADIUS accounting retirement.
report:
READ-ONLY BASIS
Read docs/architecture/testing/interop.md, authentication sections of docs/guide/l2tp.md and docs/guide/pppoe.md, plan/verification-baseline.json, current producers, and the retained tracked diff/status. The recorded head-before.stdout is b3d7bba364a1296a9b39d083062f82bff64416c7; the assignment establishes product equivalence with current 616dc2fa76. No validation, git operation, source edit, restoration or cleanup was performed. Historical before-source text was read in place; no archived .go snapshot was restored.

SUPPORTED COMMIT GROUPS — PRODUCT/SOURCE CLOSURE

1. PPPoE discovery shutdown and request-time provider resolution — CLOSED against recorded HEAD:
- internal/component/l2tp/pppoe/subsystem.go
- internal/component/l2tp/pppoe/drain.go
Reason: subsystem.go has BOTH the shutdown repair and an inherited startPPPoEAuthDrain signature migration. Keeping the current whole file requires drain.go. Stop closes the cancellation channel, joins discovery, stops PPP, joins event/auth/pool consumers, then closes the discovery descriptor; it does not hold the server-map mutex while joining. Start configures a 100ms receive timeout. SetRecvTimeout already has producers in internal/component/l2tp/pppoe/kernel_linux.go and internal/component/l2tp/pppoe/socket_other.go, neither appearing as a changed product file in the recorded status. No need to pull them into this commit. The saved pre-shutdown subsystem.go.before.txt already contains the resolver caller, explaining why a repair-local before snapshot conceals this HEAD dependency.
Verification companions: internal/component/l2tp/pppoe/discovery_reader_test.go and internal/component/l2tp/pppoe/auth_provider_reload_linux_test.go. This source group does not require the provider reload implementation or PPPoE server/PADT changes to define its interfaces.

2. Provider reload and RADIUS whole-reload rollback — CLOSED source set:
- internal/component/l2tp/plugins/authlocal/register.go
- internal/component/l2tp/plugins/authradius/register.go
- internal/component/l2tp/plugins/authradius/acct.go
- internal/component/config/transaction/events/events.go
- internal/component/config/transaction/register.go
- internal/component/plugin/server/reload.go
- internal/component/plugin/server/reload_tx.go
- cmd/ze/hub/main_reload.go
Reason: radius register.go consumes EventAccepted and the changed accountant API; reload_tx.go produces the accepted event, reload.go supplies transaction ownership and direct-server acceptance, and hub main_reload.go delays acceptance beyond the inner plugin commit. Registering the new event is a runtime dependency, not optional metadata. setClient now returns the retired client; subscribeEventBus returns cancellation; pauseAdmissions/detach/stopDetached divide reversible removal from irreversible accounting Stop. The accepted-event consumer matches transaction IDs and preserves an older accepted verdict across a newer tentative apply/rollback.
The local producer alone is source-independent: authlocal/register.go uses existing SDK callbacks and can land separately. However, existing whole-file regression coverage is coupled: internal/component/l2tp/plugins/authradius/provider_reload_test.go contains both local cases and RADIUS transitions, and shares helpers with internal/component/l2tp/plugins/authradius/provider_lifecycle_test.go. Those two files should accompany the combined provider group rather than be represented as a standalone local-only test set.
Other verification companions: internal/component/l2tp/plugins/authradius/acct_test.go and cmd/ze/hub/main_reload_radius_test.go. The latter has the ze_web build constraint.
This group is source-independent of group 1: L2TP already late-binds the provider. Claiming live replacement on PPPoE requires group 1 as well. Provider reload and whole-reload accounting cannot be split into separate current whole-file commits because both occupy authradius/register.go.

The first four files are an inseparable producer/event/consumer/platform-sibling transfer. manager.go pulls in StartSession.closeFiles, pppSession.closeFiles and PPPoE state. session_run.go then pulls in MaxFrameBufLen, ValidateLCPReply, LCPNegPolicy.PPPoE, proxy.LocalMagic and reanswerPAP. Taking whole files also takes existing LCP reply, magic, PAP replay, frame-size and nested-phase changes; these cannot be described as only the native credential repair. CHAP/MSCHAP framing siblings accompany the changed frame contract. PPPoE server.go must populate the new transport policy and its whole-file teardown changes require session.go.
Unchanged platform producer internal/component/l2tp/ppp/frame_other.go already supplies NewFDFile. No current CloseFD, blockingFD or pppEncapOverhead reference was found in internal/component/l2tp; the historical undefined CloseFD observation is not a present missing helper to implement. Current cancellation uses NewFDFile(...).Close().
Tests/verification remain a separate boundary: internal/component/l2tp/kernel_ownership_linux_test.go; internal/component/l2tp/reactor_ppp_linux_test.go; internal/component/l2tp/ppp/manager_test.go; internal/component/l2tp/ppp/auth_phase_rfc1334_test.go; internal/component/l2tp/ppp/chap_test.go; internal/component/l2tp/ppp/chap_fuzz_test.go; internal/component/l2tp/ppp/echo_test.go; internal/component/l2tp/ppp/frame_test.go; internal/component/l2tp/ppp/lcp_test.go; internal/component/l2tp/ppp/lcp_restart_counter_test.go; internal/component/l2tp/ppp/mschapv2_test.go; internal/component/l2tp/ppp/mschapv2_fuzz_test.go; internal/component/l2tp/ppp/pap_fuzz_test.go; internal/component/l2tp/ppp/rfc1661_option_length_test.go; internal/component/l2tp/ppp/rfc1661_test.go; and retained new tests internal/component/l2tp/ppp/frame_integration_linux_test.go, magic_echo_rfc1661_test.go, mtu_rfc1332_test.go, pap_ncp_lifetime_test.go, rfc2516_options_test.go (all five under internal/component/l2tp/ppp/), plus internal/component/l2tp/pppoe/padt_lifetime_linux_test.go.
